The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d8924ac01b6d4dc0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let K ⊂ Rm be nonempty, bounded, open, convex and centrally symmetric. Suppose that λQ(K) ≤ κ2 tr Q for every positive definite diagonal Q. (3) Let j1, . . . , js be distinct elements of {1, . . . , m}, and let qi : Ri−1 → [−δ, δ] be arbitrary functions, for 1 ≤ i ≤ s. There exist signs ε1, . . . , εs such that the recursion x(0) = 0, x(i) = x(i−1) + ( qi(x (i−1) j1 , . . . , x (i−1) ji−1 ) + εi ) eji has x(s) ∈ K. For i = 1, the function q1 has a one-point domain.
